description: The symbol '+' for the word PLUS in a relative LINE or NEXT GROUP operand of a report group description entry (kb/Work PB3964). ANSI X3.23-1985 prints the relative operand as the word PLUS alone; ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 115 QUOTES the change: 'PLUS or MINUS can be the symbol '+' or '-', respectively'. The 2023 text is 13.18.35.3 SR1 (LINE), 13.18.37.3 SR2 (NEXT GROUP) and 13.18.14.3 SR2 (COLUMN): 'PLUS and + are synonyms.' No MINUS operand exists in any of the three 2023 formats, so '-' names nothing to gate (the grammar refuses it at every edition). The COLUMN clause's relative operand is itself a 2002 form and is gated whole by report-multi-column-2002. Gated by recognition, VersionConformancePass ParseArm.VisitReportRelativeSign, once per written symbol.
display: the '+' symbol for PLUS in a relative LINE or NEXT GROUP operand (report group description)
citation: ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 (substantive changes not affecting existing programs), item 115; ISO §2023:13.18.35.3 SR1, §2023:13.18.37.3 SR2, §2023:13.18.14.3 SR2 (2023 text)
vcr: VCR row 7.45 (85->2002: '+' is a synonym of PLUS in a report group's relative operands)
